environment: n8n 2.48.8 (n8n start, isolated user folder) + mock Jira Cloud + SMTP sink

results.name: Happy path: two active sprints, paginated Jira, digest emailed
results.expected: Both sprints sent; Payments=Critical 29% (3 blocked, 2 stale, 2 overdue, 2 unassigned, Priya overloaded); Mobile=Healthy; 10 Jira calls incl. 3 board pages and 4 search pages
results.actual: HTTP 200; sent=2; Payments Critical 29% blocked=3 stale=2 overdue=2 unassigned=2 overloaded=Priya Raman; Jira calls=10 (sprint-11 pages=4); emails=2; rows=sent,sent

results.name: Same-day re-run is deduplicated
results.expected: Second run sends nothing (skip_already_sent); still 2 emails total
results.actual: outcomes={"Payments Sprint 4":"skip_already_sent","Mobile Sprint 9":"skip_already_sent"}; emails total=2

results.name: Manual resend with {"force":true}
results.expected: Both sprints re-sent; 4 emails total
results.actual: outcomes={"Payments Sprint 4":"sent","Mobile Sprint 9":"sent"}; emails total=4

results.name: Dry run returns a preview without sending or writing state
results.expected: outcome=preview with subject/text; 0 emails; 0 rows
results.actual: outcomes=preview,preview; emails=0; rows=0; subject="[Sprint Health] Payments Sprint 4 | Critical | 29% done | 2026-11-27"

results.name: Concurrency: 5 overlapping executions at once
results.expected: Exactly 1 email per sprint (2 total); 1 sent row per sprint, every other claim marked lost or skipped
results.actual: emails=2; rows per key={"11:2026-11-27":["1:sent","3:lost","5:lost","7:lost","9:lost"],"21:2026-11-27":["2:sent","4:lost","6:lost","8:lost","10:lost"]}; run outcomes=["sent/sent","lost_race/lost_race","lost_race/lost_race","lost_race/lost_race","lost_race/lost_race"]

results.name: Jira returns HTTP 500 twice on issue search
results.expected: Node retries (3 tries) and the run still succeeds; 2 emails
results.actual: HTTP 200; sent=2; emails=2; Jira calls=12 (incl. 2 failed)

results.name: Jira rate limit (HTTP 429) on sprint lookup
results.expected: Retried after back-off; run succeeds
results.actual: HTTP 200; sent=2

results.name: Jira down (HTTP 500 on every call)
results.expected: Run fails after 4 retries with backoff; no digest; Error Workflow emails the admin with Jira error text
results.actual: HTTP 500; digests=0; admin alert="[Sprint Health] Workflow failure: Get Scrum Boards failed: Jira GET /rest/agile/1.0/board failed after 5 attempts: HTTP 500: mock injected 500 [line 9]"

results.name: SMTP rejects the first digest (all 3 attempts)
results.expected: Payments=failed, Mobile=sent; failed row recorded; run errors; admin alerted
results.actual: HTTP 500; rows={"Payments Sprint 4":"failed","Mobile Sprint 9":"sent"}; error="Data command failed: 554 5.7.1 mock: message rejected"; admin alert=yes

results.name: Re-run after SMTP failure retries only the failed digest
results.expected: Payments sent now; Mobile skip_already_sent
results.actual: outcomes={"Payments Sprint 4":"sent","Mobile Sprint 9":"skip_already_sent"}; new emails=1

results.name: Regression: one transient SMTP rejection must not re-send other digests
results.expected: Payments retried and delivered once; Mobile delivered exactly once (no duplicate)
results.actual: HTTP 200; events=rejected, accepted:Payments, accepted:Mobile

results.name: Team-managed project: boards of type "simple", one of them Kanban
results.expected: Sprint on the team-managed Scrum board is sent; the Kanban board's HTTP 400 "does not support sprints" is skipped, not an error
results.actual: HTTP 200; outcomes={"Web Sprint 2":"sent"}; kanban board queried (400)=true

results.name: No sprint-capable boards visible to the API user
results.expected: Run fails with a clear "No sprint-capable boards" error; admin alerted; no digest
results.actual: HTTP 500; admin alert="[Sprint Health] Workflow failure: No sprint-capable boards found (types scrum/simple). Check the Jira user can browse the project, or fix Config.boardIds "

results.name: Sprint lookup returns HTTP 500 on every attempt (boards OK)
results.expected: Not mistaken for a Kanban 400: run fails, admin alerted, no digest
results.actual: HTTP 500; digests=0; admin alert="[Sprint Health] Workflow failure: Get Active Sprints failed: Jira GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/1/sprint failed after 5 attempts: HTTP 500: mock injected 500 "

results.name: No active sprint on any board
results.expected: status=no_active_sprint; no emails; no rows
results.actual: HTTP 200; status=no_active_sprint; emails=0; rows=0

results.name: Active sprint with zero issues
results.expected: Digest still sent with health=Empty, 0%
results.actual: Payments Sprint 4: Empty 0% sent; Mobile Sprint 9: Empty 0% sent

results.name: Crash recovery: stale pending claim (2h old) does not block today's digest
results.expected: Stale claim ignored; digest sent
results.actual: outcomes={"Payments Sprint 4":"sent","Mobile Sprint 9":"sent"}

results.name: In-flight protection: fresh pending claim (1 min old) from another run
results.expected: Payments skip_in_flight; no duplicate email for it
results.actual: outcomes={"Payments Sprint 4":"skip_in_flight","Mobile Sprint 9":"sent"}; Payments emails=0

results.name: Day-over-day trend from yesterday's snapshot
results.expected: Email shows "+9 pts vs <yesterday>" (29% today vs 20% yesterday)
results.actual: found "+9 pts vs 2026-11-26" in email

results.name: No active recipients configured
results.expected: skip_no_recipients; no emails, no claims
results.actual: outcomes={"Payments Sprint 4":"skip_no_recipients","Mobile Sprint 9":"skip_no_recipients"}; emails=0; rows=0

results.name: Webhook without the correct token
results.expected: Rejected (HTTP 403), workflow not executed
results.actual: HTTP 403; Jira calls=0

results.name: Sprint shown on two boards (origin board 1 + board 2): recipients of both boards, one email
results.expected: Payments sent once to team@ AND mobile@ (board 2 subscriber); Mobile sent once; 2 emails, 2 sent rows
results.actual: HTTP 200; emails=2; Payments to=[<team@test.local>,<mobile@test.local>] boards=[1,2]; sent rows=2

results.name: HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 2 on issue search
results.expected: Retried once after waiting >= 2 s (the Retry-After value, not a fixed delay); run succeeds
results.actual: HTTP 200; sent=2; first-page calls=429,200; wait before retry=2033 ms

results.name: HTTP 503 twice without Retry-After: exponential backoff
results.expected: Retries after ~0.5-1 s, then ~1-2 s (second wait >= first); run succeeds
results.actual: HTTP 200; first-page calls=503,503,200; waits=784 ms, 1675 ms

results.name: HTTP 403 on issue search is not retried
results.expected: Exactly 1 search call per sprint (no pointless retries); run fails with the 403 in the alert; no digest
results.actual: HTTP 500; search calls per sprint={"11":1,"21":1}; digests=0; admin alert=[Sprint Health] Workflow failure: Get Sprint Issues failed for sprint 11 (Payments Sprint 4): Jira GET /rest/a

results.name: Config validation and timezone check inside n8n
results.expected: Monitor reports workflow tz = Config tz (Asia/Kolkata); a workflow on America/New_York flags the mismatch; bad values are listed; matching tz passes
results.actual: monitor tz=Asia/Kolkata/Asia/Kolkata; NY workflow: 1 error ("workflow timezone is America/New_York but Config.timezone is Asia/Kolk..."); matching tz: 0 errors; bad values: 3 errors

errors: workflow timezone is America/New_York but Config.timezone is Asia/Kolkata; set Workflow Settings -> Timezone to Asia/Kolkata (or change Config.timezone) so the schedule and the digest date use the same calendar
jiraBaseUrl is not a valid URL (not a url); expected e.g. https://your-site.atlassian.net

results.name: Invalid Config stops the real run before any Jira call
results.expected: Shipped placeholder config (your-team.atlassian.net) fails in the Config node; 0 Jira calls; admin alerted with the problem list
results.actual: HTTP 500; Jira calls=0; admin alert="[Sprint Health] Workflow failure: Invalid Config (2 problems; edit the Config node or Work"
